'''Mytus VII''' was the outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Mytus system/Legends|Mytus system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Mytus VII was avoided, even by the [[Ocsin]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], due to being the near the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|penal]] facility.
